chapter_assembly: Ordered part-NN.md bytes joined with two LF characters; only first segment has chapter title.
native_client_checks: First process exits with incomplete chapter and unchanged state
Same thread ID exec resume reads real handoff and segments
Further fresh thread IDs restore from files without previous process conversation
Second long chapter repeats interruption and resume
continuity_checks: Prior object return versus new permission
Frozen original observation versus later interpretation
Limited scoped payoff versus unverified full history
Formal revision workspace and complete downstream reread/replay
Stale templates and stale reports remain detectable
final_checks: Source and actual extracted candidate tests and doctor
Final tool/build identity and source hashes
Chapter/segment counts and real text length
Final review versions and rolling coverage
Pause, unauthorised next chapter refusal, discussion resume and draft export
boundaries: No automatic Git commit, push, tag or release
Model self-review is not human, market or hundred-chapter literary acceptance
Scripts cannot determine prose quality or semantic continuity
